title: A themed Spotlight wears the accent its owner picked, in every theme, not only CyberWitch

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-05: audit every theme's Use path; the accent must carry to Spotlight.

detail: The one-accent rule (#4673) read the owner's Space accent only for CyberWitch Spotlight layouts. New World, Services, Temple, Free Human and Network Spotlights now read it too: New World and Services match the hex to a preset, Temple and Free Human to the profile that wears it, Network to the scheme. A colour that matches no preset leaves the kit's own accent. Designer follows too: the profile whose accent ramp has that colour as its base.

verify.evidence: lib/spotlight/space-accent-themes.test.ts: layout to theme map and hex to preset lookup. Closed on the owner's ruling, 2026-11-09 19:17Z. Asked how to close the shipped-pending-check rows, Daniel answered "b": close them without a production check. Any code for it that merged keeps its unit pins in CI. No production look was taken.
